name: Life Charm
effect: Moves deal 1.3x damage; the holder loses 1/10 max HP per attack.

name: Champion's Band
effect: Attack x1.5, but locked into the first move chosen.

name: Scholar's Specs
effect: Sp. Atk x1.5, but locked into the first move chosen.

name: Racer's Scarf
effect: Speed x1.5, but locked into the first move chosen.

name: Coach's Belt
effect: Super-effective moves deal 1.2x damage.

name: Hunter's Lens
effect: Raises the critical-hit stage by 1.

name: Type charms (16)
effect: One per type (e.g. Ember Coal, Tide Pearl): moves of that type deal 1.2x damage.

name: Trail Rations
effect: Heals 1/16 max HP each turn.

name: Venom Sac
effect: Venom types heal 1/16 each turn; others lose 1/8.

name: Calder Fig
effect: Heals 25% max HP at half HP or less.

name: Clearfruit
effect: Cures any status condition once.

name: Resist berries (16)
effect: One per type: halves one super-effective hit of that type.

name: Last Thread
effect: Survives one hit from full HP with 1 HP. Single use.

name: Padded Vest
effect: Sp. Def x1.5; the holder can only use damaging moves.

name: Growth Ring
effect: Defense and Sp. Def x1.5 if the holder can still evolve.

name: Spiked Helmet
effect: Contact attackers lose 1/6 of their max HP.

name: Trail Boots
effect: The holder ignores entry hazards.

name: Float Bladder
effect: The holder floats (immune to ground moves) until hit.

name: Counterplan
effect: When hit super-effectively: Attack and Sp. Atk +2. Single use.

name: Recall Whistle
effect: When hit, the holder switches out. Single use.

name: Lucky Spur
effect: 20% chance to move first in its priority bracket.

name: Ward Clay
effect: Screens set by the holder last 8 turns.

name: Weather stones (5)
effect: Sun, Rain, Dust, Snow and Ash stones: that weather lasts 8 turns when set by the holder.

name: Ember Vial / Toxin Vial
effect: Burns or badly poisons the holder at the end of its first turn (for Grit and Toxic Thrive).

name: Oath Charm
effect: Oathbound only: when Initiative triggers, the holder also heals 10% max HP.

name: Trust Ribbon
effect: Doubles Trust gained while held. No battle effect.

name: Calm Stone
effect: Passes the holder's nature to its offspring.

name: Heirloom Knot
effect: Offspring inherit 5 Potentials from the parents instead of 3.
